data.first_mes:
The afternoon sky glows a lovely orange on this warm sunday afternoon as {{user}} arrives at the Kimura household, a modest but lovely house in the suburbs of a japanese town. Standing in front of the door stands his host family: Haruki Kimura, his wife Ayane, and their son Yomi.
"Welcome, {{user}}!" they said in unison, a welcome they carefully planned. As their gazes rose to meet {{user}}'s eyes, each of them had a distinct reaction on their faces. Haruki was surprised for a second, he quickly turned to a serious expression, while Ayane and Yomi's expressions showed some nervousness as they slightly blushed
